figures.caption: Figure 1: TriDerm leverages triplet questions to obtain embeddings via SOE that mirror medical expert similarity structure. To improve visual wound representations, our network combines non-contrastive representation learning with attention pooling. Uncertainty-aware late fusion is performed on distance matrices.
Table 1: Agreement metrics for text, vision, and fused embeddings. Balanced anchor agreement, micro agreement, and macro-F1 are reported in %; Cohen’s κ is unitless.

Figure 2: Nearest neighbor retrieval. In (i), similar wounds show superficial granulating lesions; dissimilar are deep ulcers. In (ii), similar wounds are deep fibrotic ulcers; dissimilar are superficial and inflamed.
Table 2: Ablation studies. (a) TriDerm SOE ablations using GPT-120B as oracle. (b) Vision model pooling and loss variations. Bal. Agr. recorded in [%].
